user.title: Connect Frigate LPR
user.description: The MQTT integration must already be configured. Leave the camera field empty to accept observations from all cameras.

data_description.topic: The topic containing LPR updates from Frigate.
data_description.camera: Enter an exact camera name, or leave empty for all cameras.

reconfigure.title: MQTT source
reconfigure.description: Change the MQTT topic and optional camera filter.

data_description.topic: The topic containing LPR updates from Frigate.
data_description.camera: Enter an exact camera name, or leave empty for all cameras.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Choose the area you want to configure. Observations and vehicle cases are preserved when settings are changed.

menu_options.add_plate: Add or update a known license plate

menu_option_descriptions.classification: Choose when an observed plate is classified as Frequent.
menu_option_descriptions.vehicle_lookup: Enable optional vehicle data lookup for brand-new unknown plates.
menu_option_descriptions.snapshots: Select an image entity and copy its current image locally for each passage.
menu_option_descriptions.speed: Attach Frigate's estimated speed to passages and choose an advisory speed limit.
menu_option_descriptions.add_plate: Create or edit a local vehicle case with name, category and vehicle data.
menu_option_descriptions.remove_plate: Remove user data from a plate without deleting its observation history.

vehicle_lookup.title: Vehicle lookup via MotorAPI
vehicle_lookup.description: Optional lookup of make and model. Only the first observation of a brand-new unknown plate is sent to MotorAPI. Named plates and the Own, Known local and Unwanted categories are never sent automatically. The result is stored so the plate is not looked up again.

data.motorapi_enabled: Enable lookup for new unknown plates

data_description.motorapi_key: Get an API key from motorapi.dk. The key is stored in Home Assistant's configuration.

snapshots.title: Snapshot from image entity
snapshots.description: Select the image entity Frigate updates with the current vehicle image. On each passage, the image is copied locally to the vehicle case and is only replaced by the next passage for that plate.

data.snapshots_enabled: Keep latest snapshot on the vehicle case

data_description.snapshot_entity: For example, Frigate's image entity for the camera or object providing the passage image.

speed.title: Speed from Frigate
speed.description: Frigate publishes speed on the events topic. The integration matches it to the plate by event id. Select the same unit system as Frigate. Camera speed is an estimate, not an enforcement-grade measurement.

data_description.events_topic: Usually frigate/events. Change it only when the MQTT prefix differs.
data_description.speed_unit: Choose kmh for metric Frigate or mph for imperial. mph is converted and stored as km/h.
data_description.speed_limit: Used only for dashboard highlighting and statistics.

add_plate.title: Add or update a known license plate

data.name: Name
data.ignored: Ignore in overviews and traffic statistics

abort.no_known_plates: There are no known license plates yet.
